categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the research, development, production, and sales of power cord assemblies and special cables. Its products serve computing, household appliances, industrial equipment, shipbuilding, welding guns, and new energy electric vehicles. Key product categories include AC and DC power cord assemblies, precision electrical wiring, rubber cables, marine and industrial special cables, and new energy vehicle charging connectors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced technologies such as automated production lines for power cord assemblies, high-speed extrusion for precision electrical wiring, and rubber irradiation cross-linking technology. It has developed proprietary technologies in automated production, high-speed extrusion, and cable manufacturing, supported by national-level enterprise technology centers and collaborations with research institutes. Production processes include granulation, wire drawing, extrusion, and assembly, with a high degree of automation and intelligent manufacturing systems.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading global brands in computing and household appliances such as Dell, Haier, Hisense, Samsung, LG, HP, Xiaomi, Walmart, and others. The company also serves new energy vehicle manufacturers like BYD, SAIC-GM-Wuling, Geely, and Xiaomi Auto, as well as charging infrastructure providers. Markets span personal computing, home appliances, industrial equipment, new energy vehicles, and international retail chains.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with production bases in Weihai and Thailand, and subsidiaries in Hong Kong, Taiwan, Singapore, and other locations. Its products are certified and sold globally, covering major markets including China, the United States, Germany, Japan, the United Kingdom, Thailand, and South Korea. The Thailand production base supports international market expansion and local customer service.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates as an integrated manufacturer with vertical integration across the supply chain, including polymer composite material research and production, metal conductor processing, cable manufacturing, electronic accelerator irradiation, and power cord assembly. It functions primarily in the midstream and downstream segments, producing finished components and assemblies for end customers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include deepening the core markets of computing and household appliances, expanding into new energy vehicle charging connectors, and accelerating internationalization through the Thailand base. R&D focuses on new materials, automated manufacturing, high-frequency and high-speed cables, intelligent and green technologies, and expanding into high-end, specialized cable markets. The company also invests in developing products for emerging applications such as AI, data centers, and automotive high-speed communication cables.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through direct sales of physical products, including power cord assemblies and special cables. The company operates on an order-driven production model, fulfilling customer contracts and sales agreements. It does not rely on subscription or licensing but on product sales to a diversified customer base domestically and internationally.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a global leader in the power cord assembly industry and a significant player in special cables. It holds a strong market position with recognized brand influence and comprehensive international certifications. Competitors include other specialized cable manufacturers and component suppliers in the electrical machinery and equipment manufacturing sector, but the company differentiates itself through vertical integration, technology leadership, and global market reach.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 3.4 billion, representing a 37.06% increase year-over-year. Net profit attributable to shareholders was about RMB 196.5 million, with a slight decrease compared to the previous year. The company has shown steady growth in sales volume and production capacity, with expanding international sales, particularly from the Thailand base. Total assets reached over RMB 4.36 billion, reflecting ongoing investments in production and R&D.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high product quality, reliability, and comprehensive safety certifications across over 40 countries and regions. Its vertically integrated supply chain ensures cost control and supply stability. Advanced automation and intelligent manufacturing enhance product consistency and efficiency. The company’s R&D capabilities enable customized, high-performance solutions for diverse and demanding applications, including new energy vehicles and high-speed data transmission, providing customers with differentiated, innovative, and sustainable products.
